title: dryopteris rufescens
intro: Dryopteris rufescens, commonly known as Autumn fern, is a species of fern native to East Asia, characterized by its deciduous, lustrous fronds and ability to tolerate a range of environments. The Autumn fern has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion, and is believed to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anticancer activities. Additionally, the Autumn fern has been used to treat various conditions, including fever, cough, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its bioactive constituents.
